title: Business Analyst with Swift+ISO20022
description:
**Project Description:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Analyst/Requirements Engineer to join our dynamic team. You need to have a strong background in business analysis, requirements engineering, and experience with ISO20022 standards. This role will be pivotal in supporting and driving the adoption and integration of ISO20022 changes within our application.

**Responsibilities:**

* Apply domain knowledge in the finance sector, preferably in the context of ISO20022.
* Drive functional requirements for strategic projects and collaborate with stakeholders globally.
* Conduct requirements-gathering sessions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Define requirements and create comprehensive documentation, including business requirements documents (BRD), system requirements specifications (SRS), use cases, user stories, and process flow diagrams.
* Conduct gap analysis to identify and articulate to-be requirements, particularly for ISO20022 messages and standards, into system requirements, understanding overall impact on upstream and downstream applications.
* Collaborate on proof-of-concepts, pilots, and minimum viable products with the tech team.

**Mandatory Skills Description:**

* You gained at least 7-8 years of professional experience in consulting or project environment, ideally with deep knowledge of SWIFT Network and market-driven initiatives like the ISO20022 change.
* Experience in credit lending / credit risk monitoring mandatory
* Strong Risk Credit Monitoring + Techno Functional - Java.
* You have a degree in IT equivalent to Computer Science, Information Systems / Engineering.
* Proven Track Record in working on huge projects, managing change, stakeholders, business demand, and requirements engineering.
* You can contribute to IT solution design, architecture, and have technical skills, also to bridge between business and IT.
* You are an ambitious person with a structured mind and excellent analytical skills.
* You are proactive and a hands-on personality who feels comfortable managing change.
* You are an excellent communicator with all levels within the organization and fluent in English.
* Any business analysis certifications or similar

title: Engineering Manager - Vice President
description:
Join us as an Engineering Manager - Vice President at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be a successful Engineering Manager - Vice President, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: Hands-on experience in software engineering, with experience in a technical leadership role.
* Mobile Expertise: Experience with React Native, native iOS (Swift/Objective-C), and Android (Java/Kotlin).
* Web Expertise: Proficiency in React.js or similar frameworks (Angular, Vue.js).
* Technical Stack: Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
* Strong understanding of AI-native, agentic, and multi-agent architectures with appropriate governance controls.
* Engineering leadership across large-scale distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
* Proven experience driving reliability, resilience, automation, and SDLC optimization
* Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead teams, manage delivery, and foster collaboration.

**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**

* Experience in financial services or regulated environments.
* Strong Problem-solving skill and stake holder management.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.
* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: ESaaS - SFDC - MuleSoft Integration Development
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a skilled
**SFDC MuleSoft Developer**
to build, scale, and manage seamless data and process integrations between our Salesforce ecosystems (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud) and third-party enterprise applications. You will leverage the
**MuleSoft Anypoint Platform**
to design robust APIs, implement API-led connectivity, and ensure secure, high-performance data exchange.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Integration & Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable APIs and integration flows using MuleSoft Anypoint Studio and Mule ESB.
* Salesforce Connectivity: Integrate Salesforce objects, events, and custom applications using pre-built MuleSoft Salesforce Connectors, REST/SOAP APIs, and Platform Events.
* API-Led Connectivity: Implement API design principles (System, Process, and Experience APIs) following best practices.
* Data Transformation: Write complex data transformations using DataWeave. [
* Lifecycle Management: Manage the full API lifecycle—from design (RAML/OpenAPI) and publishing (Exchange) to deployment (CloudHub/Runtime Fabric) and policy enforcement (API Manager). [ 1 , 2 ]
* Quality Assurance: Perform unit testing, peer code reviews, and performance tuning for high-volume data processing. [ 1 , 2 ]
* Collaboration: Work alongside Salesforce Architects, Product Owners, and QA teams in an Agile environment to translate business requirements into technical designs (HLD/LLD). [ 1 , 2 ]

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 4+ years of hands-on integration development experience with the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. [ 1 , 2 ]
* Salesforce Knowledge: Solid understanding of Salesforce data architecture, security models, and standard integration patterns (Remote Process Invocation, Data Synchronization). [ 1 ]
* Technical Stack:

+ Proficiency in Mule 4, DataWeave 2.0, RAML, and Anypoint Studio.
+ Experience with messaging protocols and formats (REST, SOAP, JMS, JDBC, JSON, XML, CSV).
+ Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Maven). [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]

* Security & Governance: Understanding of OAuth 2.0, HTTPS, security tokens, API governance, and error handling mechanisms. [ 1 , 2 ]

**Preferred / Desirable Skills**

* Active MuleSoft Certifications (e.g., MuleSoft Certified Developer / Integration Architect).
* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I or Administrator).
* Exposure to AI/ML integrations, Generative AI capabilities, or Salesforce Data Cloud. [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]

**SFDC MuleSoft Developer**
to build, scale, and manage seamless data and process integrations between our Salesforce ecosystems (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud) and third-party enterprise applications. You will leverage the

to design robust APIs, implement API-led connectivity, and ensure secure, high-performance data exchange.

title: Engineer I Software Development
description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a seasoned full-stack engineer to build and manage entire Mobile and Web infrastructure. Successful candidates should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in below skills.
  
  
Candidates should have knowledge and experience in web development technologies like Angular, Typescript, Ionic and ReactJS. Development experience of Hybrid Web Applications Compatible with Desktop, iOS, and Android mobile Platforms will be added advantage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build, test, and deliver new features while improving the performance and quality of the product.
* Design/Develop Rich User Interface with latest web technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Angular, Ionic, ReactJS, Typescript etc.
* Building cross platform mobile app with Ionic/ReactJS.
* Develop new features, improvements and bug fixes as agreed with product manager(s).
* Participate in software and product design discussions.
* Participate in peer code reviews.
* Write automated tests for new code.
* Ensuring the entire stack is designed and built for security, speed, and scalability.
* Investigate and recommend use of new technologies/libraries where appropriate.
* Develop solutions for cloud – Azure.

**Basic Qualification**

* Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
* Enthusiasm to develop your software engineering skills

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Proficient in Ionic/ReactJs
* Experience in Ionic/ ReactJs is must.
* Experience with REST API / Web API (creation, consumption, integration) using Entity Framework or similar ORM tool or service-oriented architecture.
* Understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to tackle them.
* Proficient in at least one database technology like MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
* Understanding and knowledge of programming fundamentals - Clean Code concepts, SOLID principles, Object Oriented Design, unit testing etc
* Ability to tackle ambitious problems and work independently as well as part of a team
* Proven problem-solving skills
* Extensive experience as a Developer in Agile projects
* Strong sense of ownership and integrity demonstrated through clear communication and collaboration.
* Experience with an object-oriented language such as C# is a plus
* Knowledge of Git version control, Jira, DevOps is a plus

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**
At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

We are looking to hire a talented Android developer to design, build, and maintain the next generation of mobile applications. Your primary focus will be developing high-end applications for the latest mobile devices. You will be responsible for architecting or building these applications, as well as coordinating with the teams responsible for other layers of the product infrastructure. Building a product is a highly collaborative effort, and as such, a strong team player with a commitment to perfection is required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate designs and wire-frames into pixel perfect high quality code
* Produce fully functional mobile applications writing clean code Develop and support the entire application lifecycle (concept, design, test, release and support)

description:

We are seeking talented and motivated students interested in
**Information Technology (IT) Internship opportunities**
at our
**IT Hub in Pune, India**
for the
**January 2027 - June 2027**
internship cycle.
  
  
**Please apply through this posting to be considered for all IT Internship opportunities within the Pune IT Hub for the January-June 2027 internship program. Selected candidates will be matched to projects based on business needs, technical skills, academic background, and career interests.**
This internship posting provides an opportunity to be considered for a variety of technology-focused projects across Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Data & Analytics, and Enterprise Technology teams.
  
  
**Potential Project Areas**
As an IT Intern, you will be matched to projects based on business needs, your educational background, technical skills, and career interests. Potential project areas may include:
  
  
**AI Engineering**
Work alongside experienced engineers to help build and support AI-enabled applications and platforms. Interns may contribute to AI and machine learning solutions, cloud-based platforms, data workflows, software development initiatives, and automation efforts while gaining exposure to modern AI technologies and engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation & Agentic AI**
Partner with business and technology teams to help improve workflows through automation and emerging AI technologies. Interns may assist with business systems analysis, requirements gathering, solution testing, process documentation, system support, and implementation of AI-driven solutions that enhance productivity and user experience.
  
  
**Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI Integration (EDAIx)**
Support enterprise data and analytics initiatives that enable data-driven decision making and responsible AI adoption. Interns may contribute to data platform modernization, analytics solutions, reporting, data quality initiatives, governance activities, process automation, and the development of scalable data and AI capabilities across the organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Depending on your skills, interests, and project assignment, you may have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Contribute to the development, testing, support, and implementation of technology solutions.
* Collaborate with business and IT teams to solve real-world challenges and improve business processes.
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, automation, and AI-enabled initiatives.
* Support software development, application enhancement, and cloud-based technology projects.
* Document requirements, workflows, technical designs, and project outcomes.
* Participate in testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.
* Present recommendations and project updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Learn and apply industry best practices in software engineering, data management, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and information technology.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* Available to participate in a full-time internship from January 2027 through June 2027.
* Must be in good academic standing.
* Demonstrated interest in technology, software development, data analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, cloud technologies, or related disciplines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Strong learning agility, initiative, and desire to take on new challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with or coursework in one or more of the following:

+ Python
+ SQL
+ Data Analytics and Reporting
+ Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
+ Cloud Technologies
+ Software Development
+ Business Analysis
+ Power BI or Data Visualization Tools
+ Git, CI/CD, or related development practices

* Experience through academic, personal, open-source, or project-based work is highly valued.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

What You'll Gain
  
  

* Hands-on experience working on meaningful projects that support business and technology transformation.
* Exposure to enterprise-scale AI, data, analytics, automation, cloud, and software engineering environments.
* Mentorship and coaching from experienced IT professionals and technology leaders.
* Opportunities to collaborate with global teams across Edwards Lifesciences.
* The ability to develop technical and professional skills while contributing to work that improves patient outcomes around the world.

**Position Summary**
**USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-S&S -Salesforce Apex- Life Sciences- Consultant, Technical Transformation**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level: Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalent**
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high-quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
The candidate should have strong knowledge of Veeva CRM, Salesforce platform fundamentals, pharmaceutical commercial processes, and stakeholder management. This role will support business teams in improving CRM effectiveness, sales operations, and customer engagement capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Independently design, build, and deliver medium/high complexity stories. Use standard estimation methods for user stories.
* Own medium-complex modules; perform PoCs, grooming, present design options to TLs. Drive technical grooming; participate in solutioning and PoCs with option analysis.
* Engage juniors to follow best practices; perform code reviews and fixes with minimal oversight. Coordinate with onshore/client teams; ensure juniors understand requirements; build client rapport.
* Define release management strategy, pipeline management, repository integration with DevOps. Drive meeting agendas; support weekly status reports. Elevate industry knowledge; leverage Delivery Excellence/automation/Smartstarts.
* Configure and extend Agentforce/GenAI components; perform PoCs for GenAI-powered features. Mentor Analysts on technical tasks; support technical solutioning and PoCs.

**The team:**
Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, Integration APIs).
* Proven experience leading technical teams in Salesforce project delivery.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration, security, sharing rules, and platform best practices.
* Experience with data integration, migration, and deployment strategies.
* Proficiency in source control systems (e.g., Git) and Agile methodologies.
* Salesforce Platform Developer certification required; additional Salesforce certifications are a plus.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Project experience on Life science and Health clients (Patient experience, Commercial, Med Tech, Provider and/or Payer)
* Experience in life sciences/pharmaceutical domain & Veeva CRM
* Hands-on experience with Veeva CRM platform administration covering: Sample management, order management, and field inventory workflows.
* Veeva CRM Events Management — event creation, approval, and lifecycle management.
* Exposure to Veeva Vault or related Veeva ecosystem tools

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
:
  
  

* Knowledge of integrations, data migration, and release management
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments
* Veeva CRM certification
* Salesforce certification
* Experience with commercial operations or field force enablement initiatives
* Hands-on experience with Veeva CRM platform administration covering: MyInsights dashboard Config & KPI Design, CLM, Approved email config & template management

**Education**
:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location**
:
  
  

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

title: Senior product sofware engineer
description:
About the Role:
  
  
Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
* Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
* Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
* Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
* Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
* Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
* Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
* Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
* Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
* Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
* Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
* Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
* Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
* Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
* Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
* Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
* Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
* Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
* Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles.
* APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
* Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
* Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
* Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency.

Competencies:
  
  

* Analytical Skills
* Inclusive Collaboration
* Drive to Perform
* Accountability
* Functional Expertise
* Operational Expertise

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

title: Engineer
description:
We are looking for a strong engineer to join our Product Engineering team, working on our flagship SaaS product — a Telecom Expense Management (TEM) platform used by clients to manage, analyse, and optimise their telecom spend across complex, multi-vendor environments.
  
  
The platform is currently built on .NET, Angular, and MS SQL Server. We are actively planning a migration to a modern stack: Python, MySQL, cloud infrastructure on AWS, with components including Celery for task queuing, Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration, and AI capabilities powered by Ollama (on-premise) or AWS Bedrock.
  
  
This means the right person needs to be genuinely comfortable in two modes simultaneously: maintaining and enhancing the existing product with confidence, while actively contributing to the architectural thinking and hands-on execution of the migration to the new stack.
  
  
You will be hands-on across both stacks, working closely with the team on day-to-day development while gradually taking on more architectural responsibility as you grow into the role. This position is designed for someone who is ready to step up — technically strong, eager to lead, and looking for an environment where they can grow into a Tech Lead over time.

title: Senior/Software Engineer - Mobile App Monetization (Data Analytics)
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a passionate
**Data Engineer**
to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering
**Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real-time analytics**
. You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing
**billions of mobile advertising events**
every day, including
**ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in-app events, and auction logs**
. You'll leverage modern Big Data technologies, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to build intelligent analytics and automation solutions.
  
  
You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next-generation Mobile AdTech products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of mobile advertising events with low latency and high availability.
* Design and build ultra-low-latency, high-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — ad request → impression → click → install → in-app conversion event — including OpenRTB bid request/response logging, auction analytics, and win-rate/bid-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and Snowflake on AWS.
* Architect real-time campaign pacing and budget delivery systems, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds.
* Architect and implement real-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in-app events.
* Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics.
* Design large-scale Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules-based and ML-driven detection across billions of daily events.
* Develop backend services (Java, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. Design and develop GenAI-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks.
* Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.
* Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices.

**We'd Love For You To Have**

* 1–5+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering.
* Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles.
* Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases.
* Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS.
* Experience designing and optimizing large-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS. Strong understanding of real-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed query engines, modern data lake technologies, and high-performance analytical databases (e.g., Trino, Presto, ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) is an added advantage.
* Experience processing high-volume streaming data using Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or similar technologies.
* Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT design, and distributed computing concepts.

**Mobile AdTech Experience**

* Experience working with Mobile AdTech platforms or digital advertising ecosystems is highly preferred, including knowledge of: Direct experience with Real-Time Bidding (RTB), OpenRTB protocol, and Mobile DSP/SSP/Ad Exchange architecture.
* Familiarity with mobile SDK event tracking (impressions, clicks, installs, in-app events) and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations.
* Understanding of attribution methodologies (click-through, view-through, multi-touch based attribution).
* Knowledge of mobile identity solutions (IDFA, GAID, IDFV) and the privacy landscape driving their deprecation.
* Experience with campaign pacing, bid optimization, and budget delivery algorithms.
* Background in ad fraud/IVT detection — click spam, install fraud, SDK spoofing.

**Generative AI Experience**

* Experience building production-grade GenAI applications including: LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, etc.)
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks
* Prompt engineering and prompt optimization
* AI evaluation and observability
* AI agents and workflow automation

**Additional Preferred Skills**

* Experience building scalable, production-grade AI or data platforms.
* Strong SQL optimization and query performance tuning skills.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application development.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or AWS.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve stretch goals in a fast-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

**Qualification**
Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Our company emphasizes a proactive and efficient approach to quality assurance. The role is not merely about identifying bugs but about driving the entire QA lifecycle to ensure the integrity of the shipped product.

●
**Operational Balance**
: The role requires a blend of 70% automation and 30% manual testing efforts.

●
**Core Philosophy**
: The engineering culture centers on the "Fail fast, fail cheap, fail smart" principle. This strategy aims to identify gaps and diversions early in the development cycle through rigorous, early-stage testing to minimize downstream costs and technical debt.

●
**Ownership Model**
: As a high-ownership Individual Contributor role, the engineer is expected to lead QA initiatives independently, from initial requirement gathering through to final execution.

**Technical Competencies and Stack**

* Mobile Automation- Experience with Appium for both iOS and Android platforms.
* API & Integration- Expertise in Postman or RestAssured.
* Load & Performance- Ability to simulate traffic and assess system limits using JMeter or K6.
* Foundational Skills- Strong command of Core Java and experience with ERP systems.
* Testing Methodologies- Deep understanding of Black Box, Grey Box, and Integration testing.

**Key Responsibilities and Lifecycle Management**

The QA Automation Engineer is responsible for the end-to-end quality process. This involves high-level coordination and meticulous attention to detail.

● Lifecycle Driving: Ownership of requirement gathering, design, creation, and execution of test cases.

● Gap Analysis: Critical identification of diversions between the intended product requirements and the actual shipped product.

● Cross-functional Coordination: Effective communication and alignment within the immediate team and across other functional units to maintain high standards.

● Proactive Quality Assurance: Maintaining a high-standard, proactive approach within a fast-paced environment to prevent quality degradation.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Product Development
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Prepaid Management Services global digital presence with over 55+ websites and 10+ mobile application. We are looking for senior specialist to be responsible for maintaining the current portfolio of customer facing channels - Mobile apps, My Account, Commercial platforms. The role holder will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of product features, enhancements and work collaboratively with the relevant regional product, account management, marketing, engineering, Bizops teams, Compliance and Legal to oversee the successful delivery of the changes as well as the launch of new digital platforms and capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**

* Managing the growth of Mastercard’s Prepaid Management Services (MPMS) websites: Including product capabilities, Web, CMS and mobile app updates and constant innovation to drive business success online.
* Attending scrum ceremonies and working closely with internal web and mobile development teams, to improve the user experience and always put the customer first.
* Delivering digital platforms for MPMS and clients, including the launch of new marketing, servicing sites and mobile application.
* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

**About You**

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues.
* A team player that wishes to support an innovative and fun global team by aligning to strategy, understanding the goals of the team and always working towards success.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to work with and influence people across the organisation
* Reviews product demo against acceptance criteria for the feature set
* Supports and participates in post-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
* Enables self-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
* Owns and manages product documentation ensuring features and associated documentation are clear.
* Experience in the SAFe/Agile software development lifecycle methodology
* A background in financial services is desirable; knowledge/experience in actively managing websites or mobile apps is a must.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Dentist Mobile Polyclinic Van
description:
**Company Description**
Health Within Reach Foundation is a non-profit Section 8 Company under the Companies Act 2013, focused on delivering quality healthcare to underserved communities. The organization serves people who cannot access existing healthcare services due to distance, poverty, or conflict-related barriers. Using mobile healthcare infrastructure and technology, the foundation brings medical care directly to rural, remote, and urban locations. Its mission is to ensure that individuals who cannot reach healthcare facilities still receive essential services at their doorstep. Health Within Reach Foundation is committed to making “health within reach” a reality for all.
  
**Role Description**
The Dentist – Mobile Polyclinic Van is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division. The dentist will provide comprehensive dental care from the mobile polyclinic van, including examinations, diagnosis, preventive care, restorative procedures, and emergency dental treatment. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing patient flow, maintaining accurate medical and dental records, educating patients on oral hygiene and preventive practices, and coordinating with other healthcare professionals in the mobile unit. The role also involves ensuring proper sterilization and maintenance of dental equipment, adhering to relevant clinical protocols and safety standards, and participating in outreach activities and health camps in various communities. The dentist is expected to work closely with the foundation’s team to improve access to dental care for marginalized and resource-limited populations.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Recognized degree in Dentistry (BDS; MDS is an advantage) and valid registration with the appropriate dental council or regulatory body.
* Clinical expertise in routine dental procedures, including examination, diagnosis, fillings, extractions, scaling, preventive treatments, and basic emergency dental care.
* Experience or strong interest in community dentistry, public health, or working with underserved and diverse populations.
* Ability to work in mobile or field-based settings, including flexibility to travel within the Pune Division and adapt to varied environmental and resource conditions.
* Strong patient communication and counseling skills, with a focus on education, empathy, and culturally sensitive care.
* Commitment to maintaining high standards of infection control, equipment sterilization, and adherence to clinical and safety protocols.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including doctors, nurses, technicians, and outreach staff.
* Basic proficiency in using digital tools for record-keeping, reporting, and telehealth support; familiarity with electronic health records is a plus.
* Prior experience in mobile clinics, rural health programs, or non-profit healthcare initiatives is preferred but not mandatory.

description:

Pune, IndiaWork Mode: Hybrid – Monday to Wednesday in-office, Thursday and Friday remote

5+ years

**About InCommon**

InCommon helps global startups and businesses build, manage, and scale their teams in India.

We partner with growing companies to support their expansion through talent acquisition, Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup, compliance, payroll, and business operations.

Founded in 2023 and backed by Better Capital, InCommon works closely with companies to build strong teams across technology, AI, product, and leadership roles.

**About the Client**

We are a strategic advisory and investment firm working with private equity firms, combining deep industry insights, strong relationships, and proprietary technology to create value across the investment lifecycle. We are building an in-house platform engineering capability where technology and automation play a critical role in driving business impact.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer – AI & Automation who combines strong Salesforce development skills with architectural thinking and hands-on ownership of enterprise system integrations.

In this role, you will own Salesforce solutions end-to-end, design integrations across multiple business systems, and use AI-powered development tools such as Claude and Claude Code to improve engineering efficiency. You will also drive development standards, CI/CD practices, automated testing, and technical collaboration across developers, QA, and business stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to build scalable systems, establish engineering best practices, and help shape an automation-first development environment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience across configuration and development, including Apex, LWC, SOQL, APIs, and administration.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modelling, automation patterns, and platform design.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations across enterprise systems using REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, middleware, SQL/NoSQL databases, and third-party platforms.
* At least 1 year of experience using AI coding tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows involving code review, automated testing, and controlled deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based version control, branching strategies, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and Salesforce deployment tools such as SFDX or Gearset.
* Ability to guide developers and QA testers, review technical deliverables, and establish engineering standards.
* Active participation in Agile practices, including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and Google Apps Script for Google Workspace integrations is a plus.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud are preferred. Salesforce Architect certifications are an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution design, development, deployment, and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL queries.
* Design integration architecture across Salesforce and other enterprise systems.
* Use AI development tools to streamline requirements, coding, testing, and release workflows while ensuring code quality and production safety.
* Establish and maintain Git-based change control, code review standards, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Ensure configurations, code, and integrations are version-controlled, traceable, and auditable.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions in collaboration with the Product Manager and internal architect.
* Provide technical guidance to developers and QA teams, manage sprint execution, and support the growth of the Systems team.

**Tools & Platforms**

Candidates should be comfortable working across the following:

**● Salesforce - Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, custom objects and integrations**

**● Claude & Claude Code - primary AI development environment (enterprise license)**

**● Git-based version control - GitHub / Bitbucket, CI/CD pipelines, SFDX, Gearset or equivalent**

**● Google Workspace - Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Apps Script integrations**

**● Project management - Jira | Additional AI tooling Codex, GitHub Copilot, Agentforce**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Shape the technology behind every stage of the customer relationship Work on technology that supports customers beyond their initial interaction with DIRECTV and throughout their ongoing relationship with the brand. You’ll contribute to digital journeys and customer-facing capabilities that make interactions simpler, more connected and easier to manage. The work brings together software engineering and quality engineering to address real customer needs across the lifecycle.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Salesforce Customer Experience Engineering organization, focused on field service capabilities. This role builds and supports Salesforce solutions that enable field operations, mobile workflows, and connected customer service experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong Salesforce development expertise, field-service technology experience, and a passion for reliable mobile and connected service solutions.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Software Development:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Salesforce-based field service solutions.
* Build Lightning Web Components and Apex services.
* Support Salesforce Field Service and Mobile App capabilities.
* Use Copado to support release management and deployment.

**Technology & Delivery:**

* Translate field-service needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Develop platform integrations using MuleSoft and AWS services as appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve reliability, security, and maintainability.

**AI & Innovation:**

* Support Agentforce and Prompt Builder capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve field-service efficiency through AI and automation.
* Contribute to platform modernization and engineering excellence.

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 4-6 years of progressive software engineering experience.
* Experience developing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong experience with Lightning Web Components, Apex, and Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Omni-Channel
* Lightning Web Components
* Apex Development
* Copado
* Agentforce.

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Prompt Builder
* Salesforce Field Service
* Salesforce Mobile App
* MuleSoft
* AWS Lambda, EC2, SQS, and Kinesis.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent.

**Note:**
This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

**Talent Value Proposition statement:**

* At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.
* Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.
* DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

We are looking for an experienced
**Tech Lead – Mobile (Android + iOS)**
to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performance mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in either Android or iOS, along with a solid understanding of both mobile platforms.
  
  
The Tech Lead will be responsible for driving mobile architecture and technical decisions, establishing engineering best practices, mentoring developers, and working closely with Product, Design, QA, Backend, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance Android and iOS applications.
* Own mobile application architecture, technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Provide technical leadership across the complete application lifecycle, from requirement analysis and solution design through development, testing, release, and production support.
* Make sound technical decisions related to architecture, frameworks, libraries, integrations, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Drive adoption of appropriate architectural patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, and other modern mobile architecture practices.
* Review technical designs, conduct code reviews, and ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and quality guidelines.
* Mentor and guide Senior and Junior mobile developers through technical coaching, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.
* Break down complex requirements into technical solutions, development tasks, and actionable implementation plans.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, Backend Engineering, DevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify and resolve complex technical issues, performance bottlenecks, application stability problems, and production incidents.
* Establish and improve mobile development practices around testing, CI/CD, release management, monitoring, and application quality.
* Ensure mobile applications follow secure coding practices and relevant security and compliance requirements.
* Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and tools and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable technical or business value.
* Support estimation, technical planning, sprint planning, and delivery tracking from a technical perspective.
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to the overall technology roadmap for mobile applications.
* Ensure consistency in development practices across Android and iOS teams and promote effective knowledge sharing between platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of professional experience in mobile application development, with significant experience in Android and/or iOS development.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Android (Kotlin/Java) and/or iOS (Swift/Objective-C) development.
* Strong understanding of modern mobile application architecture, design patterns, and software engineering principles.
* Experience designing and implementing MVVM, Clean Architecture, and modular/scalable application architectures.
* Strong understanding of Android SDK and modern Android development frameworks, or equivalent expertise in iOS SDK and modern iOS development practices.
* For Android: strong knowledge of Jetpack Components, including ViewModel, Room, Navigation, LiveData/Flow, and related libraries.
* For iOS: strong knowledge of Swift, UIKit/SwiftUI, concurrency, networking, persistence, and modern iOS frameworks.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, backend services, and third-party SDKs.
* Strong knowledge of mobile application security, secure coding practices, data protection, and compliance requirements.
* Strong understanding of mobile performance optimization, memory management, crash analysis, and application stability.
* Experience with unit testing, UI/integration testing, code quality tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release processes.
* Strong experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.
* Proven experience conducting code reviews and establishing engineering standards.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging, analytical, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor mobile engineering teams.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to independently drive technical initiatives and take ownership of outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills across Product, UX/UI, QA, Backend, DevOps, and business teams.
* Ability to balance technical quality, delivery timelines, maintainability, and business requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise-grade, large-scale, or high-traffic mobile applications.
* Experience leading Android and iOS teams or working in a multi-platform mobile engineering environment.
* Experience with mobile application modularization and reusable component development.
* Familiarity with cloud services, observability, analytics, crash monitoring, and mobile application monitoring platforms.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and distributed or client-facing development teams.
* Experience working with CI/CD and automated deployment to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Exposure to cross-platform technologies such as Flutter or React Native is an added advantage.
* Experience working in regulated or security-sensitive environments is an advantage.

**What We Expect From The Tech Lead**

* Hands-on technical leadership, not just people management.
* Ability to own and communicate the mobile architecture and technical direction.
* Ability to solve complex technical problems and guide the team toward scalable solutions.
* Strong focus on code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Ability to mentor engineers and raise the overall technical capability of the team.
* Strong ownership of technical delivery and production quality.

**Location:**
Pune, India

1 PM – 10 PM IST

8+ years
  
  
****Position Overview****
We are looking for a Technical Lead to drive a scrum team for all necessary deliverables and serve as the technical face of the team for major decisions. This position will be based in our Pune office and work closely with product, engineering leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver on the Momentive Careers roadmap.
  
  
****Position Summary****
As a Technical Lead, you will be responsible for driving a scrum team to deliver project commitments and orchestrating complex application development across the full lifecycle — from concept through post-production support and maintenance of server, OS, web applications, and services. * Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID principles, and SOA design
* Deep PHP proficiency — Zend / Laminas Framework required

* 3+ years working with React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Redux Saga

* Mobile Apps: Own the strategy, architecture, and delivery of our iOS and Android apps, bringing conversational, AI-driven workflows to mobile with a fast, reliable, and secure experience.
