title: Treasury/ Payment Application Support - Swift/TRAX/Quantum – 4-8 Yrs – 24/5 Rotational Shift – Pune
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**About The Team**
The FIS Treasury Enhanced Application Managed Services (EAMS) team provides proactive functional and operational support for clients using FIS treasury and payments solutions. The team monitors critical processes, owns first-line investigation and service coordination, and connects clients with the right FIS specialists to maintain resilient day-to-day treasury operations.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The Senior Treasury EAMS Analyst independently owns complex client support and operational outcomes across treasury applications and processes. The role combines domain knowledge, structured incident leadership, client communication, cross-team coordination, and continuous improvement to reduce service risk and strengthen the quality of managed support.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own complex incidents and service requests from initial assessment through restoration, resolution, or effective hand-off, ensuring clear accountability throughout
* Analyze issues across treasury process, application, interface, data, scheduler, and infrastructure layers using available diagnostics, logs, and operational evidence
* Assess business impact and priority, coordinate resolver teams, manage escalations, and maintain accurate client and stakeholder communication
* Lead operational monitoring and validation activities covering payments, statements, interfaces, reconciliations, batch jobs, application availability, and daily treasury controls
* Drive problem management and root cause coordination, identify recurring patterns, and translate findings into preventive actions, knowledge, automation, or process improvements
* Provide functional guidance on cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, bank reconciliation, treasury accounting, messaging, and related workflows
* Lead client issue discussions and contribute to service reviews, reporting, risk updates, action tracking, and operational governance
* Support upgrades, releases, testing, change planning, cutover readiness, and post-change validation for assigned client environments
* Review and improve runbooks, standard operating procedures, controls, handovers, and knowledge articles for accuracy and usability
* Coach P2 analysts, support quality reviews, share product and domain knowledge, and help coordinate work across shifts when required
* Partner with Product Support, Technical Support, hosting, database, network, product management, professional services, and third parties to deliver end-to-end outcomes
* Promote a service ownership culture grounded in security, privacy, auditability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement

What you bring
  
  
**Required Experience And Domain Knowledge**

* 4-8 years of relevant client services, treasury, banking, payments, financial services application support, or managed services experience
* Strong working knowledge of treasury operations including cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, accounting, bank reconciliation, statements, and daily controls
* Practical understanding of SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 messaging. Examples may include MT101, MT202, MT210, MT300, MT5xx, MT9xx, pain, and camt messages
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, service requests, escalations, problem investigations, and root cause activities in an SLA-driven environment
* Experience communicating directly with clients and explaining technical or operational issues in clear business language
* Willingness to work flexible rotational shifts aligned to the approved global support model

Technical and operational skills
  
  

* Experience with a Treasury Management System or payments platform. FIS Trax, Quantum, Integrity, eBAM, Bank Connector, or Payment Hub experience is advantageous
* Ability to interpret logs, application diagnostics, job and interface statuses, data validation results, and monitoring alerts
* Working knowledge of SQL concepts and databases such as Oracle or SQL Server
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable service management and monitoring tools
* Understanding of hosted or cloud environments, secure file transfer, system dependencies, and application architecture
* Working knowledge of SFTP administration and troubleshooting, including SSH key-based authentication, host-key validation, permissions, directory and file conventions, and coordination with infrastructure or security teams
* Strong written documentation skills for ticket updates, handovers, procedures, and knowledge content
* Manage and support SWIFT FileAct and SWIFT FIN services for payment processing, statement delivery, and financial messaging
* Support ERP integrations for payment processing and bank statement reconciliation across treasury platforms
* Monitor and maintain Host-to-Host (H2H) banking connectivity to ensure seamless communication between enterprise systems and banking partners
* Provide application support for Treasury Management Systems (TMS), ensuring operational stability and timely issue resolution
* Create and maintain static data within the Treasury Management System, including bank accounts, counterparties, and related configurations
* Perform CEV (Connectivity and End-to-End Validation) activities to validate treasury and banking integrations
* Handle ServiceNow incidents, service requests, and change requests, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with SLA commitments
* Support integration and processing of MT940 and MT942 bank statement messages received from SWIFT and banking partners
* Analyze, validate, and support payment message formats including ISO 20022 PAIN.001/PAIN.002 and SWIFT MT101/MT199 messages
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, banks, and technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues and ensure uninterrupted treasury operations
* Participate in monitoring, incident management, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives related to treasury applications and banking connectivity

Core competencies
  
  

* Strong service ownership and sound judgment in complex or ambiguous situations
* Confident client-facing communication and stakeholder management
* Analytical problem solving, risk awareness, and disciplined root cause thinking
* Ability to prioritize competing incidents, requests, planned activities, and client commitments
* Coaching mindset with commitment to team capability, quality, and knowledge sharing
* Attention to detail with a track record of producing high-quality operational documentation

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, Commerce, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred. Treasury, payments, SQL, cloud, or service management certifications are advantageous
* Experience with FIS Trax, Quantum, Integrity, eBAM, Bank Connector, Payment Hub, or other TMS System
* Experience supporting multiple clients or products in a global managed services environment
* Exposure to service reporting, operational governance, audit support, user administration, and controlled static-data management
* Experience contributing to automation, monitoring enhancement, or continuous service improvement
* Ability to facilitate operational calls and guide less experienced analysts during high-priority issues

What success looks like
  
  

* Complex issues progress with clear ownership, effective coordination, accurate impact assessment, and timely communication
* Recurring incidents and operational risks are converted into measurable corrective or preventive actions
* Client interactions demonstrate confidence, transparency, domain knowledge, and sound expectation management
* Operational controls, documentation, and shift handovers consistently support reliable and audit-ready service delivery
* P2 analysts gain capability through coaching, review, and practical knowledge transfer
* Service quality improves through stronger monitoring, procedures, automation, and cross-team collaboration

What FIS offers you
  
  

* A role with meaningful responsibility supporting global treasury and payments operations
* Learning and career development opportunities across products, operations, technology, and client service
* Exposure to global clients, cross-functional teams, and industry-leading treasury solutions
* A collaborative, inclusive environment that values ownership, continuous improvement, and client outcomes

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description: Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXRVenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds with LLMs rather than around them.What You'll BuildFeatures, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.Tech StackFrontend: React.jsBackend: Python, DjangoAI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCPAI-native, and we mean it literallyMost job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of: Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building itWhat we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.What You Need One to two years shipping product React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight. At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holdingYour work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.What HelpsEach one moves you up the list. Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness Working knowledge of Generative UI. AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus. Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domainHow We Work Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked Vitality — energy that holds up in month sixIn practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.The processThe take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for. Tech screening round — 30 minutes. Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying. Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it. Interview round 2 - Technical + ManagerialBaner, Pune. Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker

title: Software Development Engineer [PSET-Product Data-Data Foundation]
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101416
  
  
**Position Overview**
Autodesk's Platform team is seeking a motivated Software Engineer (Java AWS) to join our growing engineering organization. Our ecosystem is built around cloud-native services and modern applications that power Autodesk's platform capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of Autodesk's cloud data platform while learning to build reliable, scalable software used by millions of customers worldwide. You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, and product managers and gain hands-on experience with modern cloud technologies and engineering practices.
  
  
You will be based in
**Pune**
and report to the Manager of Software Development. We offer a flexible hybrid work model.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* Develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain high-quality software primarily using Java and Spring Boot
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices
* Work with experienced engineers and architects to understand technical designs and translate requirements into software features
* Contribute to cloud-native services and RESTful APIs running on AWS
* Build automated unit and integration tests to improve software quality and reliability
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering skills
* Learn and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and production support practices
* Collaborate with team members to diagnose and resolve software defects and production issues
* Contribute ideas that improve engineering practices, developer productivity, and product quality
* Use modern AI-assisted development tools and practices, including code generation, automated reviews, and Spec-Driven Development, with appropriate engineering validation and oversight

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 0 to 2 years of software development experience, including internships, academic projects, open-source contributions, or professional experience
* Good understanding of Java and object-oriented programming concepts
* Understanding of fundamental data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
* Familiarity with Spring or Spring Boot, gained through coursework, projects, internships, or professional experience
* Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and web application development.
* Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases
* Experience using Git or another source-control system
* Understanding of software testing concepts, including unit and integration testing
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
* Ability and enthusiasm to learn new technologies and work collaboratively in an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in the following areas is helpful but not required:
  
  

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, including services such as S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, or IAM
* Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native application development
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools
* Experience with shell scripting or Linux development environments
* Exposure to application monitoring, observability, or production support
* Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications
* Exposure to streaming or distributed data technologies such as Apache Flink
* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools

****Learn More****
**About Autodesk**
Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.
  
  
We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.
  
  
When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!
  
  
**Salary transparency**
Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
**Belonging**
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging
  
  
**In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification**
This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

* Past record of successful delivery of trading systems on a global scale.

* Strong understanding of Equities, GUIs, and existing vendor offerings in this space.

 the engineering bar

 environment

title: Technical Lead - AI First Approach
description:
**Job: Technical Lead (AI\-First \| Strong Fundamentals \| MVP Builder)**




  





 At
 **Infotech.Works** 
 , we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
 **2–6 months** 
 , starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.

 **Technical Lead** 
 who combines
 **deep engineering fundamentals** 
 with
 **AI\-powered speed** 
 —someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade\-offs, and still ship fast.
 



 This role is for someone who can
 **think deeply and execute quickly** 
 .

* Translate business ideas into
 **robust technical architectures and system designs**
* Lead
 **discovery sessions** 
 and create structured solution blueprints
* Design and build
 **MVPs that are fast to launch but don’t collapse at scale**
* Make key decisions on:
* Data models
* System boundaries
* API contracts
* Performance trade\-offs
* Guide developers through
 **clean implementation, code quality, and design thinking**
* Introduce reusable patterns and
 **standardized architecture approaches**
* Use AI tools to accelerate development—
 **without compromising engineering quality**



  





**Core Requirement: Strong Engineering Fundamentals (Critical)**




 We are
 **not** 
 looking for surface\-level developers who rely only on AI.
 



 You must be strong in:
 



  





**Database Design** 



* Schema design (normalized vs denormalized)
* Indexing strategies and query optimization
* Handling large datasets and performance bottlenecks
* Designing for reporting, analytics, and scalability
* Writing efficient SQL and understanding execution plans



  





**System Design \& Architecture** 



* Designing scalable, modular, and maintainable systems
* Clear understanding of:
* Monolith vs microservices (and when NOT to over\-engineer)
* API design and contract\-first thinking
* Caching strategies, queues, background jobs
* Ability to design systems that evolve from
 **MVP → scale without rework**



  





**Problem Solving** 



* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured solutions
* Strong debugging and performance optimization skills



  





**AI\-First Mindset (Equally Important)** 




 You should actively use AI to
 **move faster** 
 , not to replace thinking.
 


* Daily use of tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor
* Ability to
 **learn new stacks quickly using AI\-assisted workflows**
* Comfortable integrating APIs like OpenAI API into products
* Use AI for:
* Rapid prototyping
* Debugging
* Code generation
* Architecture exploration



 The key difference:
 



 You
 **verify, refine, and improve AI output using strong fundamentals** 




  





**Experience Required**



* 7–10 years of software development experience
* Proven track record of
 **shipping multiple MVPs or products end\-to\-end**
* Experience in
 **startup, product studio, or consulting environments preferred**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead small teams



  





**Technology Expectations**




**Backend** 



* Laravel (PHP), Node.js (Express/Nest), or Python (Django/FastAPI)
* Strong API design and integration experience



**Frontend** 



* React / Next.js / Vue
* Ability to quickly build functional, usable interfaces



**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, SES, CloudWatch)
* Docker, CI/CD, Git



**Databases** 



* Strong expertise in MySQL / PostgreSQL (must\-have)
* Exposure to NoSQL is a plus



  





**Who You Are**



* You understand
 **why things work** 
 , not just how to use them
* You can
 **design systems from scratch** 
 , not just assemble components
* You are comfortable with ambiguity but
 **bring structure quickly**
* You move fast—but
 **never compromise on core design quality**
* You use AI as a
 **multiplier** 
 , not a crutch



  





**Ideal Candidate Mindset**




 “I can design the system, optimize the database, and ship the product. AI helps me go faster—but I know what good engineering looks like.”

title: Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for a Flutter developer to join the mobile team behind MyMotor, Zoop’s consumer vehicle services application available on Android and iOS. The app helps users look up vehicle registration details, check and pay traffic challans, store documents, and access insurance, FASTag, fuel price and EV charging services.
   

  

 You will work on a single production Flutter codebase used by customers daily, on a small
   

  

 team where you will own features end to end, from design handoff through to release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test and ship new features in the MyMotor Flutter application for both Android and iOS.
* Translate Figma designs into accurate, responsive Flutter screens consistent with the existing design system.
* Integrate REST APIs using Dio: build request and response models, and implement loading, empty and error states for every screen.
* Manage application state using Riverpod, following the state management patterns already established in the codebase.
* Implement offline\-first behaviour and local data caching using Hive.
* Instrument analytics events (Firebase Analytics, CleverTap) to support product funnels and conversion tracking, on both success and failure paths.
* Monitor Crashlytics, triage crashes and production issues, identify root causes and ship fixes.
* Ship features behind Firebase Remote Config feature flags so they can be enabled or disabled without a store release.
* Write and maintain unit tests, and contribute to expanding widget and integration test coverage.
* Work within the established design patterns of the codebase, including Template Method base classes, the repository and source abstractions and factory\-produced navigation transitions, extending them rather than working around them.
* Participate in code reviews, raise clean pull requests, and follow the documented architecture patterns and coding standards of the repository.
* Update in\-repo technical documentation alongside the code you change.
* Support the release process, covering build flavors, QA builds and store releases through the CI/CD pipeline.
* Coordinate with backend engineers on API contracts, and with design and product on requirements.
* Test on real devices across a range of Android and iOS hardware, not only simulators.


**Stack**
* Language and UI: Dart 3, Flutter, targeting Android and iOS from one codebase.
* State management: Riverpod (hooks\_riverpod) with Flutter Hooks.
* Navigation: GoRouter, with authentication\-aware redirects.
* Networking: Dio, behind a single configured client with request and error interceptors.
* Local storage: Hive, with generated type adapters.
* Backend services: Firebase Authentication, Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config, Cloud
* Messaging and Performance.
* Analytics: Firebase Analytics, CleverTap and the Meta SDK.
* Other: Google Maps with marker clustering, WebSockets for real\-time data, payment
* gateway integration, deep linking, and Kotlin and Swift for platform\-channel work.
* CI/CD: Codemagic, with build flavors for production and UAT.


**Required Skills**
* 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience building mobile applications with Flutter and Dart.
* At least one application published to the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, or a
* substantial project you can demonstrate and explain in detail.
* Strong Dart fundamentals: sound null safety, futures, async/await, streams, collections and
* extensions.
* Practical experience with at least one state management solution (Riverpod preferred; Bloc,
* Provider or GetX acceptable, with an understanding of the trade\-offs).
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, parsing JSON, and handling network and error states.
* Ability to convert design files (Figma or similar) into accurate user interfaces.
* Familiarity with Flutter navigation, app lifecycle, and building layouts that work across
* multiple screen sizes.
* Debugging skills using Flutter DevTools, and the ability to reproduce an issue before fixing it.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with Riverpod specifically (AsyncNotifier, family and autoDispose providers).
* Experience with local databases such as Hive, SQLite or Drift.
* Experience with the Firebase suite: Authentication, Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config,
* Cloud Messaging.
* Experience with Google Maps in Flutter, marker clustering, or location services.
* Experience with WebSockets or other real\-time data handling.
* Exposure to payment gateway integration or transactional / fintech applications.
* Basic Kotlin or Swift, and familiarity with platform channels, build flavors and app signing.
* Experience with mobile CI/CD tools (Codemagic, Fastlane, Bitrise or GitHub Actions).
* Experience with analytics and product instrumentation tools such as CleverTap.
* Experience writing unit, widget or integration tests for Flutter.


**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience with a strong portfolio will also be considered.


 Skills:\- Flutter, riverpod, Firebase, iOS App Development, Android Development and DART

* Experience in SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) storefront or equivalent will be a plus.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.


**Leadership Expectations:**
* At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.


**Strategic Thinking \& Vision**
* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long\-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long\-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* Ownership \& Accountability
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high\-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision\-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team\-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.


**Innovation \& Continuous Learning**
* Champion modern engineering practices, AI\-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk\-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.


**Commercial \& Consumer Mindset**
* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer\-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.


**Building PUMA's Future**
* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

- Implement automated regression gates in CI for Launcher performance and stability.

- Architect proactive health dashboards integrating device telemetry, firmware version correlations, and user\-visible error rates.

* Android TV / STB: Leanback Library, TV Compose, D\-pad/focus engine, Google TV UX guidelines, HDMI\-CEC, 4K rendering
* Performance: Perfetto, Systrace, Android Profiler, Janky Frames, TTID, memory analysis, GC tuning
* AI / ML Integration: TFLite, ML Kit, on\-device inference, recommendation pipelines, semantic search embedding
* Architecture: Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, modular Gradle, SDK design, API versioning, backward compat strategy
* Testing: JUnit5, Espresso, Robolectric, Compose UI testing, screenshot testing, CI/CD pipelines
* Languages: Kotlin (expert), Java (proficient), C/C\+\+ (working knowledge for NDK/HAL), Python (scripting)


**Experience Requirements**
* Total Android Engineering: 7–10 years
* AOSP Launcher / SystemUI: 5\+ years hands\-on AOSP development
* Android TV / CTV / STB: 4\+ years dedicated Android TV product delivery
* Jetpack Compose: 3\+ years production Compose (phone \+ TV surfaces)
* Technical Leadership: 3\+ years leading Architect or Principal\-level squads
* FOTA / OTA Systems: Experience with firmware lifecycle, phase rollouts, A/B OTA
* Performance Engineering: Demonstrable ownership of Launcher startup/frame budget


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience at OEMs (Samsung, OnePlus, Sony, Philips, TCL, Xiaomi) or telco device platforms (Reliance Jio, Airtel Xstream, Tata Play).

* Experience with Google TV certification and GMS compliance processes.
* Familiarity with content delivery platforms, CMS\-driven UI personalization, and A/B feature experimentation on Android.
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms or LLM\-based feature integration on Android surfaces.
* Published technical talks, blog posts, or open\-source projects related to Android platform/Launcher engineering.
* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. Advanced degree a plus.

Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of an Associate Director, Software Engineering
   

  

 In this role, you will
   

  

* Analyse Android/iOS mobile malware (static/dynamic), extract IOCs, and explain risks to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Guide on protection against mobile malware, cyber, and fraud attacks.
* Gather and monitor mobile threat intelligence; stay current on trends and zero\-day threats.
* Lead resolution of complex security issues and act as primary IT Security contact for mobile.
* Educate teams on secure development and best practices.
* Collaborate with vendors, platform teams, and SMEs.


 To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in mobile malware analysis and reverse engineering (Android/iOS), and related risk mitigation.
* Strong knowledge of iOS/Android security architectures and threat landscape.
* Ability to set up analysis environments and recreate attack scenarios.
* Proficiency in at least one relevant programming language (e.g., Swift, Kotlin, Objective\-C, Java).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with DevOps/Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, JIRA)


**Non\-technical Skills**
* Security certifications (e.g., OSCP, GIAC).
* Experience with AI\-based attacks and mitigation.
* Degree in a relevant field (desirable).


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: TTT-GenAI-Staff
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job title**
 Agentic AI – Application Developer (.NET) \- Staff
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for
 **Staff** 
 with expertise in
 **full\-stack application development** 
 using
 **.NET, C\#** 
 for
 **Agentic AI applications** 
 to join the TTT team in the Tax Service Line. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneering firm while playing an instrumental role in the growth of Agentic AI transformation
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and implement AI agents/plugins/interfaces and APIs, ensuring integration with various systems aligns with the core product/ platform development strategy.
* Maintain effective communication within the team and with stakeholders, proactively managing expectations and collaborating on problem\-solving.
* Contribute to the refinement of development/engineering methodologies and standards, anticipating potential issues and leading the resolution process.



**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Must\-Have:**
* Skilled in full\-stack application development with .NET C\#, REST Api, React or any other typescript based UI frameworks, SQL databases
* Working knowledge of Azure services such as Azure app services, Azure Functions, Azure Foundry Services etc
* Understanding of Containerisation – Docker, Azure container apps, Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS)
* Working experience with source control such as git or TFVC
* CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions etc
* Working experience with AI Coding platforms such as GitHub copilot, Cursor, Claude or similar
* Generative AI application development with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Agent Framework/ Semantic Kernel, MCP, Vector databases like Azure AI search, Postgres, etc
* Fundamental understanding of various types of Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Fundamental understanding of Retrieval Augment Generation (RAG) techniques
* Fundamental understanding of classical AI/ML
* Skilled in Advanced prompt engineering


**Nice\-to\-Have:**
* Awareness about various AI Agents/ Agentic workflow frameworks and SDKs
* Graph Database such as Neo4j
* Experience with M365 Copilot Studio
* Microsoft Azure AI\-900/ AI\-102 Certification


**Behavioural Skills:**
* Excellent learning ability.
* Strong communication skill.
* Flexibility to work both independently and as part of a larger team.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in software engineering / information technology / BE/ B.TECH
* An overall 3 – 5 years of experience.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Oracle Cloud Integration - Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Enterprise Performance
   

  

 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 Level: Oracle Cloud Integrations (OIC/VBCS) – Senior Consultant
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

 Work you’ll do:
   

  

 Collaborate with team members to understand business processes and technical requirements , translating them into strategic Oracle Cloud application solutions. Architect, design, and oversee the development and configuration of advanced technical components for Oracle ERP Cloud modules, including integrations, reports, and data conversions. Direct fit\-gap analysis, technical documentation, code development and unit testing , ensuring adherence to best practices and quality standards. Provide expert guidance in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions. Drive collaboration with global teams to deliver high\-quality Oracle Cloud technical solutions and mentor junior team members, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 The T eam:
   

  

 Our Oracle Enterprise Solutions team partners with clients to modernize their core business environments, leveraging Oracle ERP Cloud, EBS, and other Oracle products. We work collaboratively to deliver projects that drive digital transformation, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes across industries.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Must Have Skills
   

  

* 7 to 11 years of technical experience in Oracle Cloud implementation or upgrade projects, with expertise in Oracle development tools (e.g., Reports\-BI Publisher, OIC Integrations, VBCS/APEX Extensions, FBDIs etc.)
* Architect and oversee the design and development of enterprise\-grade integrations in OIC with Oracle ERP Cloud, including REST/SOAP calls, FBDI/HDL file uploads, and BI Publisher data extraction.
* Provide strategic technical leadership and mentorship for integration teams, ensuring best practices and optimal performance.
* Direct the implementation of complex inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Cloud and third\-party applications.
* Demonstrate expert\-level proficiency in XSD, WSDL, SOAP, XSLT, JSON, and REST for integration architecture and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments .
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)


 Good to Have Skills
   

  

* Extensive experience with Oracle technologies, including Oracle technologies (ODI, OBIEE, OCI), Informatica and Oracle Cloud (SaaS) , and Oracle certification.
* Deep functional expertise in Financial, Manufacturing, Distribution, and SCM modules.
* Strong command of industry standards, guidelines, and best practices across IT enterprise environments.


 Education:
   

  

* BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M . S ( CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


 Location:
   

  

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


 Shift Timings:
   

  

* Applicable as per business requirements
